query:
SELECT state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status, primary_winner, pct_reporting, notes
FROM governor_races WHERE status IN ('Voting', 'Primary Runoff') ORDER BY state_code;

rows.notes: Kay Ivey is term-limited. Open seat.

D nominee: Keisha Lance Bottoms (former Atlanta Mayor) won D primary. R primary runoff (July 2026): Burt Jones (Trump-endorsed Lt. Gov.) vs. Rick Jackson (MAGA billionaire) — Raffensperger eliminated. Winner faces Bottoms in November.
Pillen term-limited; open seat. D: Lynne Walz (sister of former MN Gov. Tim Walz). R primary May 12, 2026.
2026 Ohio Governor's race: Amy Acton (D) vs Vivek Ramaswamy (R). General election November 3, 2026.

Incumbent Tina Kotek (D) seeking re-election. Primary May 19, 2026. D primary: Kotek runs essentially unopposed. R primary: Christine Drazan (2022 nominee, frontrunner), Chris Dudley (2010 nominee), Danielle Bethell, and 11 others. Rated Solid D — Kotek won 2022 by 2.5% in a three-way race; without a third-party spoiler, margin expected to be wider.
